# Acme

Acme is an enterprise data integration platform that keeps your warehouse, CRM and finance systems in sync. Teams use Acme to move records between the systems they already run, without writing and maintaining pipelines themselves.

## Built for enterprise

Acme provides enterprise-grade access controls, encryption in transit and at rest, and activity logging, so your security team can approve a rollout with confidence.

## Connects to the tools you already use

Acme connects to Snowflake, Databricks, Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday and dozens of other systems. Set up a connection once and Acme keeps it running.
